title: Corgo's 77 Collection: NPCs (Unofficial) for Cyberpunk RED - Core
description:
Unofficial Foundry conversion of Corgo's NPC stat blocks for Corgo's 77 Collection by Corgopolis: 114 ready-to-drop mook actors, one folder per faction, carrying real copies of their weapons, armor, cyberware, and gear. Adds a compendium only; it does not change the Cyberpunk RED - Core system. Works on its own; the Corgo's 77 Collection module is recommended for the items.

This is unofficial content provided under the Homebrew Content Policy of R. Talsorian Games and is not approved or endorsed by RTG. This content references materials that are the property of R. Talsorian Games and its licensees.

recommends.reason: The NPCs carry their own copies of Corgo's items; this module adds the full item compendiums.
